text: Every year in January, BSR collects old Christmas trees in Berlin. This is a free service. The Christmas tree pickup dates can be found on the BSR website.
Every year in January, BSR collects old Christmas trees. The collection dates ( Abholtermine) depend on your address. Tree disposal calendar – Berliner Stadtreinigung

section: Leave your tree on the sidewalk
text: Remove all the decorations from the tree, and bring it outside 1 or 2 days before the collection date. Leave the tree on the sidewalk, close to the street. It should not get in the way or block the sidewalk. The trees are used to make biogas.
